Thanks, this is close to what we scoped, and the osr21 credit is in both the README and the commit body. I read the diff at 720f270 and ran it in a clean clone: 50 of 50 pass, and the original 36 tests pass unchanged against your code. Three things before I merge, each confirmed by running it:

1. An unknown `operator_id_format` is silently treated as v0. `"V1"` or `"v2"` falls into the v0 branch, and the result carries no format marker, so a typo downgrades the caller with no signal. Please return `unknown("invalid_operator_id_format", ...)` for any value other than "v0" and "v1", with a test
